name: Santa's Wild Workshop at the Idaho Falls Zoo
venue: William J. Maeck Education Center at Idaho Falls Zoo
when_note: Saturday, December 12, 2026, 11 AM to 2 PM; animal encounters at 11:15, 12:15 and 1:15
paras: The Tautphaus Park Zoological Society hosts Santa's Wild Workshop at the William J. Maeck Education Center at the Idaho Falls Zoo on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 11 AM to 2 PM.

Kids pay $10 each and adults are free, and every child must come with an adult. The day includes festive crafts, a photo with Santa and Mrs. Claus, and a meeting with an ambassador animal, with animal encounters at 11:15 AM, 12:15 PM and 1:15 PM.
tip: Buy tickets ahead of time on Eventbrite and pick an animal encounter time when you arrive.

name: Journey to the North Pole Holiday Light Show Cruise
when_note: Daily from November 28 through December 31, 2026 (cruises run through January 3); 40-minute cruises leave at 4:30, 5:30, 6:30 and 7:30 PM
cost: Adults $30.50; seniors 55 and up $29.50; youth 6 to 12 $15; children 5 and under free
paras: The Coeur d'Alene Resort runs its Journey to the North Pole cruises on Lake Coeur d'Alene from November 26 through January 3. Each 40-minute cruise leaves from the Resort Plaza Shops at 115 S. 2nd St., with departures at 4:30, 5:30, 6:30 and 7:30 PM and extra times on some days.

Tickets are $30.50 for adults, $29.50 for seniors 55 and up and $15 for youth 6 to 12, and children 5 and under ride free. Guests see more than 1.5 million lights from the water, then visit Santa and his elves at his waterfront toy workshop, where Santa speaks to each child by name.
tip: Pick an early departure if your kids go to bed early.

name: Post Falls Winterfest
address: 408 N. Spokane St., Post Falls, ID 83854
paras: The City of Post Falls hosts its annual Winterfest at the City Hall Plaza, 408 N. Spokane St., on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 4 to 8 PM. Admission is free.

Kids can see Santa in his workshop, Mrs. Claus in her kitchen and the elves in their workshop. The night also has a holiday tree lighting and caroling, photo spots, kids' activities, outdoor fire pits and snacks, plus a vendor market, a Christmas tree lot, a Toys for Tots collection and a canned food drive.
tip: Dress warmly, since most of the fun is outdoors around the fire pits.

name: Hayden Lights Parade and Christmas Tree Lighting
paras: Hayden holds its Lights Parade and Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony on Saturday, December 5, 2026, starting at 5 PM. The parade begins at Hayden Avenue and heads south along Government Way to Honeysuckle Avenue, and the tree lighting at McIntire Family Park follows right after.
The community event is free and includes a visit from Santa, games and giveaways. Hayden Recreation and Community Events can answer questions at 208-209-1080.
tip: Grab a spot along Government Way early, since the parade starts at 5 PM.

name: Children's Christmas Party at the American Legion
address: 1138 E. Poleline Ave., Post Falls, ID 83854
paras: The Post Falls American Legion Auxiliary hosts a Children's Christmas Party at American Legion Post 143, 1138 E. Poleline Ave., on Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 1 to 3 PM.
The party is free, no reservations are needed, and it is open to kids ages 12 and younger. Call 208-773-9054 for more information.
tip: Walk in anytime during the two hours, since no sign-up is needed.

name: A Night in Bethlehem
venue: LifeSource Community Church at Community United Methodist Church
address: 1470 W. Hanley Ave., Coeur d'Alene, ID 83815
when_note: Saturday, December 19, 2026, with performances at 4 PM and 5:30 PM
paras: LifeSource Community Church presents A Night in Bethlehem on Saturday, December 19, 2026, with two free performances, one at 4 PM and one at 5:30 PM. The church is at 1470 W. Hanley Ave.
Families walk through three indoor live nativity scenes where actors and musicians bring the Bethlehem story to life. Tickets are free and are claimed on Eventbrite.
tip: Claim free tickets for your time slot ahead of time.
